title: 第24章
content:
【精灵：藤藤蛇】【性别：雌】【特性：唱反调】【资质：红色】【个体值：HP（24）攻击（21）特攻（26）防御（25）特防（24）速度（31）】【实力：19级】【技能：刀叶，青草搅拌器（三重），大蛇瞪眼，藤鞭，寄生种子，青草场地。】【亲密度：85（它很信任你）】【愉悦值：75（今天就要参加对战了，会在里面遇到厉害的宝可梦吗？）】7月15号。林枫起了一个大早，喂了藤藤蛇最后一枚神奇糖果。如此。藤藤蛇原本在18—19级的实力，彻底变成了19级。而且，据它所说，已经有种隐隐要进化的感觉了。就是看这个进化，到底是什么时候了。巡视了一眼种植园，没有发现什么意外后，便安心的抱着藤藤蛇来到梧桐小镇出口。出口处，已经陆陆续续站了好些个人。通往梧桐市的公交车也在这个时候，开了过来，发出“滴滴”的喇叭声。林枫正打算迈步上去。一道略显急促的喊叫声，却让他顿足了一下，随后露出了无奈的表情，看了一眼司机，示意让他等等。“等一下，还有人呀！”秦姝快跑着来到公交车门口，大口大口的喘着气，正准备感谢司机伯伯多等了一下，抬头却看见了林枫看呆子一样的表情。不过她完全不在乎这点。而是惊喜道：“枫哥？”“上来吧，你今天不是要去参加宝宝杯吗？”林枫说了一声，然后随意找了一个座位坐了下去。后者嘿嘿一笑，心中也知道是林枫帮她拦下了车子，屁颠屁颠的就跟了过去，坐在他的身边。“枫哥，你怎么知道宝宝杯是今天举行呀？”林枫打开窗户，让清晨凉爽的风吹醒最后一丝困意，“因为我也参加了呀。”秦姝的笑意顿时一僵，“啊？真的假的。”“当然是真的...我像那种喜欢开玩笑的人吗？”听到林枫这样的回答，她的表情顿时垮了下来，表情也变得纠结了起来，“怎么会？那我的第一名就没了呀！”如果说第一次，她还有挑战林枫那只藤藤蛇的勇气。那在见过藤藤蛇释放青草搅拌器和青草场地后，

这个勇气就彻底没了。于是。整趟车上，她都是沉浸在伤心的情绪中。......下车后。秦姝的脸上又带上了自信，“虽然第一名拿不到了，但第二名也不错....”林枫无奈的扶了扶额头，这孩子还真是单纯呀，永远对生活抱有很大的期望。不过这样也好。成为一名合格的训练家，在前期的时候，确实需要单纯一点。因为宝可梦本身也是一种单纯的生物。就像他记忆中的某位“傻东西”。这样能让她在训练家的前期，得到大部分宝可梦的好感。今天的旺旺超市门口，早就已经站满了人。一群少年少女，围聚在一起，叽叽喳喳的讨论着这次的宝宝杯。他们的身边，跟着各种各样的宝可梦。喇叭芽，小拉达，波波，可达鸭，波波，绿毛虫...嗯，只能说实力差距非常大。比如绿毛虫和波波撞上了，是怕波波饿着吗？“林枫？！”一道略带着疑惑的询问声，在人群中响起。循着声音看过去，一个留着三七刘海发型，穿着背带裤的少年在人群中尤为的突出。“徐坤呀...”见到来人，林枫先是一愣，随后露出了笑容。这是他们一个班的同学，平常喜欢打篮球和唱歌。两人的关系一般，属于那种见面点头之交的类型。“你怎么也来参加宝宝杯了？不是听说你去继承家里面的种植园了吗？”徐坤有些诧异的道。在班上，林枫的名声还是挺好的。一来是因为成绩好，只要有人问他问题，基本上都会回答。再加上人也长得清秀帅气，所以在女生群体中，还捞了一个班草的美誉。只是后面迟迟不选择第一只宝可梦，在训练家高考中，得了一个文科全省前十。至于训练家考核，则是得了零分。不过，依靠着文科成绩，林宇只要想去任何一所大学，也是可以做到的。
content_en:
[Elf: Vine Snake] [Gender: Female] [Characteristics: Rebellious] [Qualification: Red] [Individual Value: HP (24) Attack (21) Special Attack (26) Defense (25) Special Defense (24) Speed ​​(31)] [Strength: Level 19] [Skills: Blade, Grass Blender (Triple), Big Snake Glare, Vine Whip, Parasitic Seed, Grass Field.] [Intimacy: 85 (It trusts you very much)] [Pleasure value: 75 (I will participate in the battle today, will I encounter powerful Pokémon in it?)] July 15th.Lin Feng got up early and fed the Vine Snake the last magical candy.in this way.The original strength of Vine Snake at level 18-19 has completely changed to level 19.Moreover, according to what it said, there is already a faint feeling that it is about to evolve.Just look at when this evolution happened.After inspecting the plantation and finding nothing unexpected, he calmly carried the Vine Snake to the exit of Wutong Town.At the exit, many people were already standing one after another.The bus leading to Wutong City also drove over at this time, making a beeping sound.Lin Feng was about to step up.A somewhat urgent shout made him pause for a moment, then showed a helpless expression, glanced at the driver, and motioned for him to wait."Wait a minute, there's someone else!" Qin Shu quickly ran to the door of the bus, panting heavily. She was about to thank the driver for waiting a little longer, but when she looked up, she saw Lin Feng's idiotic expression.But she didn't care about that at all.Instead, he said in surprise: "Brother Feng?" "Come up, aren't you going to participate in the Baby Cup today?" Lin Feng said, and then he randomly found a seat and sat down.The latter smiled, knowing in her heart that it was Lin Feng who helped her stop the car, so she followed him and sat next to him."Brother Feng, how do you know that the Baby Cup is held today?" Lin Feng opened the window and let the cool morning wind wake him up from his last sleepy state, "Because I am also participating." Qin Shu's smile suddenly froze, "Ah? Really or not." "Of course it's true... I'm likeAre you the kind of person who likes to joke?" When she heard Lin Feng's answer, her expression suddenly fell and she became confused, "How could that happen?Then my first place would be gone!" If it was the first time, she still had the courage to challenge Lin Feng's vine snake.After seeing the Vine Snake release the Grass Blender and the Grass Field,

This courage is completely gone.then.During the entire car ride, she was immersed in sadness....after getting off the car.Qin Shu's face was filled with confidence again, "Although I can't get the first place, the second place is not bad..." Lin Feng helplessly held his forehead. This child is really simple and always has great expectations for life.But that’s fine too.To become a qualified trainer, you really need to be simple in the early stages.Because Pokémon itself is a simple creature.Like some "silly thing" in his memory.This will allow her to win the favor of most Pokémon in the early stages of being a trainer.Today, the door of Want Want Supermarket is already full of people.A group of boys and girls gathered together and chattered about this baby cup.Surrounding them were various Pokémon.Trumpet Bud, Rattata, Bobo, Duckling, Bobo, Green Caterpillar... Well, it can only be said that the difference in strength is very big.For example, when the green caterpillar collided with Bobo, was it because he was afraid that Bobo would be hungry?"Lin Feng?!" A slightly confused voice sounded from the crowd.Following the sound, a young man with bangs and overalls stood out among the crowd."Xu Kun..." Lin Feng was stunned for a moment when he saw the visitor, and then smiled.This is a classmate of theirs who usually likes to play basketball and sing.The relationship between the two is average, the type of acquaintance that they just nod when they meet."Why are you here to participate in the Baby Cup? Didn't I hear that you inherited the plantation at home?" Xu Kun said in surprise.In the class, Lin Feng's reputation is quite good.Firstly, because of his good grades, as long as someone asks him a question, he will basically answer it.In addition, he is also pretty and handsome, so among the girls, he has gained a reputation as a class leader.It's just that he hesitated to choose his first Pokémon later. In the trainer's college entrance examination, he got a top ten in the province in liberal arts.As for the trainer assessment, he got zero points.However, relying on his liberal arts scores, Lin Yu can do it if he wants to go to any university.
